items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: "He said, 'Old Top, I know you used to play horn,' he said, 'But I done heard so much about your tone being so bad.' ... I had the trumpet under my bed. I just reached and got the horn out and warmed up. And I played ... And he said, 'Ain't nothing the matter with your tone.'"

ctx.x: Old Top, Old Top. He said, "Old Top, I know you used to play horn," he said, "But I done heard so much about your tone being so bad." He said, "Get your horn and play something for me. I just want to hear. I want to see for myself." You know, I had to convince him. I had the trumpet under my bed. I just reached and got the horn out and warmed up. And I played -- ba-da-la-la-la-di-di- And he said, "Ain't nothing the matter with your tone." He said the guys all said I had a nanny tone. Well, you know, that was…
